onetime relaxation of RRs of the Group ‘A’ Technical Cadre of Information Services
Division of EPFO was made to MoLE, so that the existing vacancies can be filled till the

amendments to the RRs are approved and notified. Since there are no eligible candidates in
the feeder cadre for promotion in 5 years to the posts of AD (IS), DD (IS) and Director (IS), it
has been ensured that the proposed relaxation will not have any impact on promotional
avenues of the exiting incumbents during the time period for which recruitment is proposed to
be done.

3. The proposed onetime relaxations are as below-

i. For Director (IS), Deputy Director (IS) and Assistant Director (IS) of IS cadre
deputation percentage [Column 10 of RR] is proposed to be increased to 50% from
existing 20%. For Joint Director (IS) the percentage is not proposed to be increased as
it may impact promotions of Deputy Director (IS).

ii. Further, in the RRs of Director (IS), Joint Director (IS), Deputy Director (IS) and
Assistant Director (IS) of IS cadre, Column 11 of the RRs may be relaxed to allow

Officers holding analogous posts on regular basis or its equivalent from Autonomous
Organisations/ Statutory Bodies/ PSUs/ CPSUs/ Institutions working under the Central
or State Government for deputation (Including short-term contract) to widen the scope.
4. The proposed relaxations are hereby placed on the Official Website of EPFO for inviting
comments from stakeholders. Any suggestions/ comments/ views on the various clauses of the
same along with supporting DoP&T guidelines and rule position etc may be intimated within

15 days. The same may be sent only to the e-mail id rc2.hrd@epfindia.gov.in. Comments
forwarded on this issue to any other e-mail id shall not be taken into consideration.

(This has the approval of competent authority)
